objective: Test whether lagged official ETF share changes provide stable incremental cross-sectional forward-return information beyond simple momentum.
availability_rule: A trading day's published total share is treated as usable only from the next trading day. Signals at date t therefore use share facts no later than t-1.

validation.increment_rule: For a signal-direction hypothesis to pass Stage1, it must have positive mean Rank IC in at least 2/3 folds and exceed the best momentum baseline mean Rank IC on at least two forward horizons.
